# #3607: Patch (part 3 of 6): keyword loops on a budget: a minion's keyword treatments move only while it holds a motion slot
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

### What it does

Part of #3604. Most keyword treatments loop forever on every board minion that has the keyword. `cards/keywordVisuals.ts` gives `chain-sway`, `ward-shimmer`, `venom-drip`, `crack-flicker`, `vein-pulse`, `echo-rise`, `rune-glow`, `glint-twinkle`, `shockwave` and the rest `motion: { when: "always" }`, and `keywords.css` runs each `.kw-anim` `infinite` while `data-kw-motion="on"` (R438). These loops ignore the motion-slot budget that caps moving faces at `COSMETIC_FOIL_ANIMATED_MAX` (6) (`cards/motionSlots.ts`, R3340000, R1295000). They don't pause off screen and the shed ladder never touches them (`fx/shed.ts`). A full board with two or three looping keywords a minion runs several dozen infinite animations, most of them repainting SVG.

Put the keyword loops on a budget. Pick the simplest of:

- (a) a minion's looping treatments move only while its face holds a motion slot, and otherwise show their still frame. The face already claims a slot through `motionSlots.ts`, and the hovered face ranks first.
- (b) a budget of their own, a named constant such as `KEYWORD_LOOPS_ANIMATED_MAX`, ranked as the motion slots are: hovered first, then newest.

Either way they stop while off screen (the `IntersectionObserver` `artLive.ts` already has) and at `SHED_FACES` and deeper. `when: "canAct"` treatments (Charge, Rush) keep showing that the minion can act, since that tells the player something. Keep them looping only while it can act, still under the budget, or as a still mark if the budget is full. The still frame of every treatment must still read as its keyword. Record the decision as a ruling from this issue's block (CLAUDE.md rule 3).

### Acceptance

- On a board of 14 minions each with three looping keywords, at most the budget's number of minions have `data-kw-motion="on"`, and the hovered minion is always one of them (component test).
- A face scrolled off screen, a hidden page, and the shed ladder at `SHED_FACES` each set every keyword loop still.
- Reduced motion still runs none, as today.
- Each keyword's treatment still renders its still frame with its `data-keyword-fx` attributes, so the existing keyword tests and e2e selectors pass unchanged.
- The proving tests are named after the new ruling, and `cargo jackioh spec check` passes.

### Blocked by, part of

Part of #3604
